lines.text: Don't you like tea? Say no!
Many learners say: Yes, I don't like tea.
Better: No, I don't like tea.
No! Don't you like tea? No, I don't.

quiz.stem: Don't you like tea? ___, I don't.

native.tip: 中文问“你不喜欢茶吗”，会答“是的，我不喜欢”。英语的 yes 和 no 看的是答案本身：喜欢就是 yes，不喜欢就是 no。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Yes, I don't like tea.”😅 中文可答“是”，英语不喜欢就要答 no：“No, I don't like tea.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“No, I don't like tea.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In Chinese you may say yes here, but in English say no when you don't like it.
en.caption: Do you say “Yes, I don't like tea.” 😅 In English, say no when you don't like it: “No, I don't like tea.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
